column1: # AUTHORED. Frozen funnel denominators, with the date the search behind them was last run.
# Why this exists: build_release.py computed papers_screened as a LIVE recount of papers.tsv,
# and triage.py's paper set includes a live EuropePMC accession-mention sweep (82 of 505). So
# the number drifted upward every time triage re-ran, with no change to our own inputs: a
# rebuild on 2026-10-15 moved it 491 -> 505 while the Undermind seeds had not changed since
# 2026-10-05. A reviewer-facing denominator that grows on rebuild is not a denominator.
# Leon's call 2026-10-15: freeze it and state the search date. The date below is 2026-10-13,
# when release/funnel.tsv was first generated with 491 (commit 9b58669), NOT 2026-10-14 as
# first suggested: the methods statement should name the day the search actually ran.
# Unfreezing is legitimate, but it means re-running the search, re-reading what it returns,
# and updating BOTH columns here in the same commit. Changing the value without moving the
# date, or the reverse, makes the claim untrue.
